name: get_product_detail
description: Return product information: description, price, and each variant with its SKU and availability. SKUs follow the pattern <product_id>-<nn>, numbered from 01 in the order the variants are listed, so a variant's SKU can be read off its position without a further call once the product is known.

product_id.description: Catalogue product identifier, e.g. P0007. Not a SKU.

error_returns.when: No product exists with the given product_id.
